bad.title: Delete removes the contact for real
bad.text: Nothing is kept, so the later Undo has nothing to bring back.

bad.title: Back as a blank with a question mark
bad.text: Maya Chen returns with No phone · No email, at the bottom of the list.
bad.wait: Delete Maya Chen, then press Undo to see this.

good.title: Delete only marks the contact
good.text: The full record stays until the way back closes.

good.title: Back in place, details intact
good.text: Maya Chen returns first in the list, with her number and email.
good.wait: Delete Maya Chen, then press Undo to see this.

bad.title: One tap deletes a photo
bad.text: The whole tile is the delete button, so a stray tap is easy.

bad.title: Undo lasts two seconds
bad.text: Barely time to read “Photo deleted” before the button goes.
bad.wait: Delete a photo to see this.

bad.title: Gone before people look back
bad.text: A slip noticed a moment late can’t be fixed.
bad.wait: Delete a photo and wait two seconds to see this.

good.title: Same one-tap delete
good.text: Slips still happen, so the way back has to wait for people.

good.title: No timer on the toast
good.text: Undo stays while people finish reading, until they delete the next photo.
good.wait: Delete a photo to see this.

bad.title: One click, twelve files gone
bad.text: No question first, so a slip deletes Tax return 2025.pdf for good.

bad.title: Empty, with no Undo either
bad.text: The lease and the wedding photos can’t be brought back.
bad.wait: Press Empty Trash to see this.

good.title: Same button, one question first
good.text: The click opens a question instead of deleting.

good.title: Cancel has focus
good.text: A reflex press of Enter keeps the files.
good.wait: Press Empty Trash to see this.

good.title: The button says Delete 12 files
good.text: People confirm the action itself, not a vague OK.
good.wait: Press Empty Trash to see this.

bad.title: The only Undo, for three seconds
bad.text: Once the toast leaves, the archived email has no way back.
bad.wait: Archive an email to see this.

bad.title: No Edit menu, no shortcut
bad.text: Ctrl+Z only gets “Nothing happened. The email stays archived.”

good.title: Undo on the toast, as before
good.text: Quick right after, but no longer the only way back.
good.wait: Archive an email to see this.

good.title: An Edit menu that stays
good.text: Undo is still here, and on Ctrl+Z, after the toast leaves.

good.title: Undo names what it undoes
good.text: It reads Undo archive “Lunch on Friday?”, so people know what comes back.
good.wait: Archive the first email, then open Edit to see this.

bad.title: The preview’s font runs small
bad.text: Names that fit here can still be too long for the badge.

bad.title: The printed badge cuts it off
bad.text: Alexandria Montgomery fit in the preview, then printed cut off.
bad.wait: Type Alexandria Montgomery and press Print to see this.

good.title: Same size as the printed badge
good.text: What fits here fits on paper, and what’s cut off here is cut off there.

good.title: A warning before printing
good.text: “The name won’t fit on one line” shows while people can still shorten it.
good.wait: Type Alexandria Montgomery to see this.

bad.title: Every size waits its turn
bad.text: Drag from 12 to 22 and the page plays back each size, seconds behind.

bad.title: Redrawing… on every move
bad.text: People stop, wait for the page, and find they overshot.
bad.wait: Move Text size to see this.

good.title: The page keeps up with the drag
good.text: A slightly blurred version shows each size as the slider moves.

good.title: Let go and it sharpens
good.text: The full page replaces the rough one a moment after release.

bad.title: Looks the same as the real app
bad.text: Pick Dark and nothing says it isn’t applied yet.

bad.title: Back leaves without a word
bad.text: People leave thinking they have Dark, and the app stays Light.

good.title: Preview · not applied, in words
good.text: Screen readers announce it too, not only the outline.

good.title: An outline around the preview
good.text: The blue ring stays until people press Apply or Cancel.

good.title: Back asks before leaving
good.text: “Apply the Dark theme?” lets people decide instead of losing it.
good.wait: Pick Dark, then press Back to see this.

bad.title: The switch doesn’t switch
bad.text: Turning off Sounds opens a box, and the switch stays on.

bad.title: A preview for a one-line change
bad.text: Cancel and Apply, for something a second tap would undo.
bad.wait: Turn off Sounds to see this.

bad.title: Six clicks for three switches
bad.text: Every setting costs two clicks, so people stop reading the previews.

good.title: The switch takes effect at once
good.text: Sounds turns off on the first tap.

good.title: Undo covers the rare slip
good.text: “Sounds turned off” with Undo stays for five seconds.
good.wait: Turn off Sounds to see this.

good.title: Three clicks for three switches
good.text: Half the clicks, with the same way back.

bad.title: Oct 21, 15:10 hides the photos
bad.text: Nothing on this line says it’s the version that added them.

bad.title: Opened counts the guessing
bad.text: People open one version after another to find the one before the photos.

good.title: Added three photos marks the spot
good.text: The line below it, Added the menu, is the one people want.

good.title: One more open finds it
good.text: People go straight to Added the menu, so Opened stops at 2.

bad.title: Restore v1 throws away v2 and v3
bad.text: One click on the wrong row loses the vegan option and the salt change.

bad.title: Only v1 is left
bad.text: Nothing newer remains to go back to, so the restore can’t be undone.
bad.wait: Press Restore on v1 to see this.

good.title: Restore adds, never removes
good.text: Every newer version stays in the list below the restored one.

good.title: v1 comes back as v4
good.text: Labeled Restored v1 (first draft), with v3 still one Restore away.
good.wait: Press Restore on v1 to see this.

bad.title: Only a day and a time
bad.text: Nothing says this drops two slides and today’s title.

bad.title: Five slides people expect to keep
bad.text: Votes and Snacks vanish on Restore, with no warning first.

good.title: The lost slides, by name
good.text: Votes and Snacks are listed, so people know what they’d lose.

good.title: Today’s version stays in the history
good.text: Restoring is safe to try, since people can go back to today.

bad.title: Counts up toward an unseen cutoff
bad.text: Deleted 12 days ago never says the trash empties at 30 days.

bad.title: Items vanish without notice
bad.text: Three weeks on, the Lisbon booking is gone with no warning.

good.title: The 30-day rule, at the top
good.text: People know how long they have before something is gone for good.

good.title: Days left on each email
good.text: Flight booking · Lisbon shows 18 days left, so people can act in time.

good.title: Red with a week or less left
good.text: After one week, Weekly newsletter turns red at 1 day left.
